housing.summary: Numbeo reports a June 2026 average of SEK 6,625 per month for a one-bedroom apartment in Sundsvall city centre (https://www.numbeo.com/cost-of-living/in/Sundsvall). Mitthem's official listings are at https://www.mitthem.se/ledigt/lagenhet; Sundsvall municipality identifies Mitthem as the city's largest landlord (https://sundsvall.se/kommun/kommun-och-politik/kommunens-organisation/bolag-stiftelser-och-forbund/mitthem). No Sundsvall-wide deposit norm was grounded in the opened sources.

banking.summary: Swedbank's official newcomer checklist requires an in-person branch visit without Mobile BankID, completed application and tax-residency forms, approved identity documentation, a Skatteverket coordination-number extract if one has been assigned, and supporting evidence of account purpose or finances; a residence permit is required in applicable cases.
required_docs: Completed bank application and tax-residency forms
Approved passport or, for eligible EU/EEA applicants, an approved EU/Schengen national identity document
Skatteverket register extract showing a coordination number, if assigned
Supporting evidence of account purpose or finances, such as an employment contract, salary document, benefit or pension document, or statement from a previous bank

schools.summary: Västermalms skola in Sundsvall offers the International Baccalaureate Diploma Programme, taught in English (https://sundsvall.se/kommun/utbildning-och-forskola/gymnasium/sundsvalls-gymnasium/vastermalms-skola/vara-program/international-baccalaureate-diploma-program). Sundsvall municipality's school directory covers municipal and independent compulsory schools.

legal_admin.summary: A newcomer planning to live in Sweden for at least one year generally must notify the Swedish Tax Agency through the Moving to Sweden service, book an appointment, and attend a state service centre for an identity check with original identity documents.
legal_admin.registration_step: Notify the Swedish Tax Agency of the move and complete the in-person identity check at a Swedish state service centre; population registration generally applies when the intended stay is at least one year.

tax_finance.summary: The Swedish Tax Agency assigns a Swedish personal identity number when a newcomer is entered in the Population Register. A person staying for less than one year is generally not population-registered and may instead need a coordination number.
tax_finance.tax_id_name: Swedish personal identity number (personnummer); coordination number (samordningsnummer) for some shorter stays

transport.summary: Din Tur is the local public-transport network (https://destinationsundsvall.se/english/destination/travel-to-destination-sundsvall). On 31 August 2026, its temporarily subsidised 30-day adult ticket for Sundsvall urban-area travel cost SEK 416.50 (https://www.dintur.se/halva-priset-30-dagar/). EEA licences may be exchanged by valid-licence holders permanently resident in Sweden; among non-EEA licences, only licences from the UK, Faroe Islands, Switzerland or Japan may be exchanged under stated conditions (https://www.transportstyrelsen.se/en/road/driving-licences/i-have-a-driving-licence/). A newcomer staying at least one year generally registers with Skatteverket; once registered in Sweden, the person receives public medical and dental care on the same terms as other residents, while Försäkringskassan's e-service or form 5456 is used when information is needed for benefits, insurance assessment or an EHIC (https://www.forsakringskassan.se/english/moving-to-working-studying-or-newly-arrived-in-sweden/move-to-sweden).
transport.driving_licence_exchange: A valid EEA licence can be exchanged if the holder is permanently resident in Sweden. For non-EEA licences, only licences from the United Kingdom, Faroe Islands, Switzerland or Japan may be exchanged under the authority's conditions; other non-EEA licences cannot be exchanged.
transport.healthcare_registration: For a stay of at least one year, generally enter the Swedish Population Register through Skatteverket; once registered in Sweden, public medical and dental care is available on the same terms as for other residents. Provide information to Försäkringskassan through its e-service or form 5456 when seeking benefits, an insurance assessment or an EHIC.
